title: How working together looks
subtitle: Three steps. The first one is paid — which is exactly why you leave it with an answer rather than a sales pitch.

steps.title: Consultation or diagnosis
steps.duration: 200 PLN net / 30 min · 300 PLN net / hour
steps.description: You pick the format: a consultation when you have questions and want to know which way to go, or a diagnosis when something is broken and the cause has to be established. Either way you get a concrete answer, even if that is where we stop.

steps.title: Plan and quote
steps.duration: diagnosis cost comes off the project
steps.description: I write down what the cause is, what to do first and what it costs. The plan is yours — you could take it to someone else. If we do the project together, the cost of the diagnosis comes off the quote.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.description: I do what we agreed — in instalments, with a clear end result. I leave documentation behind, so anyone else can work on it after me.
